about_the_game:
Beijing Lanmei"is a popular MOP live action interactive film and television game based on urban romance novels. Players will transform into the story's protagonist Ye Ning, and as they progress through chapters and make choices, the development and outcome of the plot will be influenced. Through the game, players will encounter four charming and diverse beauties, and together, they will embark on a sweet and exciting journey. The game consists of 6 chapters, and as the game progresses, you will unlock individual love stories with each girl.

You need to pay attention to the heart rate of each beauty. As the main storyline progresses, when any girl's heart rate reaches 100, you can unlock a separate side storyline. You will have one-on-one interactive storylines with the corresponding girl. If you are a dating expert, you will have the opportunity to unlock interactive storylines with multiple girls at the same time.

It's better to take action than to be tempted. Come and challenge yourself to unlock four charming and diverse beauties.

content_descriptors.notes: game includes fantasy violence, use of alcohol, and mild partial nudity.
